turns.question: Which of 1 or 2 October 2026 had more precipitation in Amsterdam, and how many orders were placed by customers in the Netherlands on that day?
turns.answer: The semantic layer has no precipitation metric, so I cannot say which of 1 or 2 October 2026 was wetter in Amsterdam; the closest metric, orders by customer country, shows 3 orders placed by customers in the Netherlands on 1 October 2026 and 3 on 2 October 2026.
